name: Pillar Security
tagline: Discover, govern, and secure the AI agents across your organization.
description: Pillar Security is an end-to-end platform for securing enterprise AI — from discovering every AI agent, model, and integration in use to red-teaming them and enforcing runtime guardrails. It maps the AI supply chain across code, SaaS, and endpoints, then layers on governance, data-privacy controls, and compliance mapping. It targets AI-specific risks such as prompt injection, jailbreaks, and data poisoning.
insight: Founded in 2023 by Dor Sarig and Ziv Karliner; raised a $9M seed led by Shield Capital in April 2025.

modelSupport.notes: Secures AI apps and agents regardless of the underlying model; integrates with code, SaaS, and cloud AI platforms.

edge: Covers the whole AI lifecycle — discovery and supply-chain mapping, agentic red-teaming, and runtime guardrails — not just input/output filtering.
pros: Maps AI use across code, SaaS, endpoints

references.title: Pillar Security Banks $9M for AI Security Guardrails
